Title: The Effects of a School-Based Atopy Care Program for School-Aged Children
Author: Ryu & Lee
Comment: M_diff computed as group_2_mean − group_1_mean (4.3 − 4.6 = −0.3) from the two explicitly reported post-test means of a simple two-group between-subjects comparison; higher CDLQI = worse QoL, so sign must be reversed downstream so that positive favours the intervention. Title: Pediatric Atopic Eczema: The Impact of an Educational Intervention
Author: Grillo et al.
Comment: Per-arm sample sizes for the CDLQI subgroup are not reported; only the subgroup total (n=23) is given. M_diff computed as intervention mean minus control mean (1.75 - 7.08) from explicitly reported week-12 means in a simple two-group between-subjects design; negative value indicates lower (better) CDLQI in the intervention group.; n_treatment(11) and n_control(12) assumed equal split from n_total=23
